## This release

Navigate folders with a stable sidebar, clickable hierarchy and a clear Parent
control. Returning to a parent marks the folder you left; rescans retain your
location. Long names, empty folders and unreadable results have clearer states.

Updates are visible in the bottom bar. Windows MSI copies can download, verify,
install with Windows consent, and restart directly from the app. Download progress,
verification, errors and retry are visible without entering Settings.

Whole-drive scan speed is unchanged. See [navigation evidence and known limits](https://github.com/lord007tn/rilldisk/blob/{tag}/docs/NAVIGATION.md).
